tonight.headline: Won in all but name — now Week 9 has two Steelers on bye
body: Bad news first, and it is next week's: Jaylen Warren and DK Metcalf are both Steelers, and Pittsburgh are on bye in Week 9 (league file). Kyler Murray, who throws to Jefferson and Hockenson, left Detroit with hamstring tightness; this afternoon's searches found no diagnosis or Monday update.

This week is done for AVIATO: 158.06 final against Guillo-tinas' 76.24, with ESPN projecting them to 99.8 after Monday night. 3-5 by tomorrow. Nothing has moved since 07:00 — no transactions in either direction — and the one move left is still the Coker claim, clearing Wednesday 02:00.

case.label: What is left
case.body: Guillo-tinas need about 82 points from Bears-Seahawks; ESPN projects them to 99.8. Nothing AVIATO can do changes it.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing realistic: a Monday-night line of 80+ from their remaining players.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Claim clears Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX — he misses Week 8 either way
doFirst.title: Claim Jalen Coker back, drop Ka'imi Fairbairn
doFirst.subtitle: Still on Chem waivers at 22:05Z Monday, clearing Wed 4 Nov 02:00 CDMX. With Warren and Metcalf on bye in Week 9 he fills a real slot; Carolina play Denver. If the claim is already in, leave it.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 28 Oct 15:13Z: ADD Commanders D/ST, DROP Jalen Coker. The card that morning said drop Fairbairn — a second kicker. AVIATO still carry two kickers.

case.label: The player
case.body: Thursday at Green Bay he played 86% of the snaps and ran 38 routes (RotoWire 30 Oct): 2 catches on 5 targets for 38 and a 26-yard touchdown, and a lost fumble on the final play (Rotoworld, Week 8); 9.6 points (archive). Carolina's full-time No. 2 behind McMillan; his shoulder cleared before Week 8 (full practice Tuesday, off the report). Week 9 is home to Denver.

case.label: Why Week 9 sharpens it
case.body: Pittsburgh are on bye (SportsNet Pittsburgh 1 Nov), so Warren and Metcalf both sit. AVIATO's Week 9 RB/WR group is Tuten, Gordon, Kamara, Jefferson, Wilson and Diggs — six players for five slots, one spare, and that spare (Kamara) has a back that kept him limited or out of nine straight practices (DraftSharks 26 Oct). Coker is the cover for one injury.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Fairbairn cannot start while Bass kicks (16 on Sunday); Chem starts one kicker. A stated exception to the churn rule: the 28 Oct drop was not the plan.

case.label: The clock
case.body: Waivers clear Wed 4 Nov 08:00Z — 02:00 CDMX (league file clearsAt). Chem priority resets weekly; AVIATO are 10th and rival claims are invisible.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Coker scores less than Diggs over Weeks 9-10 (archive). Untested (EXPIRED) if the claim is not placed or a rival wins it.

doFirst.sources: League file activity and clearsAt · RotoWire snaps 30 Oct · SportsNet Pittsburgh 1 Nov · DraftSharks 26 Oct · archive Week 8 · Rotoworld Week 8 · re-checked 22:05Z

whatWentWrong.title: The defence add dropped Coker
whatWentWrong.lead: The D/ST add on 28 Oct cut Coker instead of the spare kicker; the claim card above undoes it.

case.label: What happened
case.body: Activity log 28 Oct 15:13Z: ADD Commanders D/ST, DROP Coker. Fairbairn stayed and has not been startable since Bass arrived.

case.label: What it cost
case.body: Nothing in Week 8 — Carolina had played and the Commanders D/ST scored 13. It costs in Week 9, when two Steelers sit.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: The claim fails and Kamara and Diggs cover Week 9 without a loss of points against Coker (archive) — then the mistake was free.

whatWentWrong.title: Two starters share a Week 9 bye
whatWentWrong.lead: Warren and Metcalf are both Steelers; Pittsburgh do not play next week.

case.label: The gap
case.body: Warren is the RB2 starter and Metcalf the bench receiver. With both out, Kamara and Diggs both start and one more injury leaves a slot with no healthy option behind it.

case.label: The fix
case.body: The Coker claim, already on the card. No second move is needed.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Week 9 projections show Kamara and Diggs both above any wire receiver including Coker — then the claim is depth, not cover.

worthALook.name: Mike Washington Jr.
worthALook.lead: Kubiak's call, not an injury: 25 carries to Jeanty's two, and Jeanty says he was told beforehand.

case.label: The player
case.body: 25 carries for 83 yards at the Jets; Jeanty had 2 carries and 3 catches for 64 (NBC 1 Nov; ABC7 2 Nov).

case.label: Why not yet
case.body: Kubiak: "That's my call, and Ashton still going to be a big part of our team." No injury anywhere; the NY Post floated unofficial discipline but called it unconfirmed (Yahoo 1 Nov). One game at 3.3 a carry. No Monday press-conference quote found at 07:00 CDMX.

case.label: The drop if it happens
case.body: Ka'imi Fairbairn would already be gone for Coker; the next would be Alvin Kamara, a committee receiving back with a back injury.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: A Raiders depth chart or Kubiak quote on Monday or Tuesday naming Washington the lead — then claim. Jeanty back to 15+ carries in Week 9 makes it a pass.

worthALook.sources: NBC 1 Nov · ABC7 2 Nov · Bleacher Report 1 Nov · Yahoo/NY Post 1 Nov

case.label: Why not yet

case.label: What would change it
